headline: Greenlam Industries Limited: General Updates
sum: General Updates - Greenlam Industries Limited has informed the Exchange about Acquisition in Bhadla Minigrid Solar 4 Private Limited, a special purpose vehicle established for owning and operating a captive power plant.
